description: This Kotlin source file defines a class SecurePrefs that handles secure storage of a user PIN in Android's SharedPreferences. It uses salted SHA-256 hashing for PIN verification, incorporating methods for setting, validating, and checking the presence of a PIN.

classes.name: SecurePrefs
classes.description: A class providing secure storage and verification of a PIN using salted SHA-256 hashing within Android's SharedPreferences.

methods.name: hasPin
methods.description: Checks if a PIN has been stored by verifying existence of salt and hash entries.

methods.name: setPin
methods.description: Generates a salt, hashes the PIN, and stores both securely in SharedPreferences.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates a provided PIN by comparing its hash with the stored hash.

methods.name: hash
methods.description: Computes the salted SHA-256 hash of the PIN.
